currentMainBehavior: Option summaries remain attached to their own options; nested Germany parts render after the option summary.
The reader does not consume previewContext or previewBriefs. This content change alone does not enable selected-provider replacement or default-scope gating.
presentationContract: previewContext binds part guidance and metadata to an explicit local decision and option.
previewBriefs supplies replacement guidance for an exact selected vendor reference. An unmatched provider retains the core guidance.
For form_001, the provider selected at n1 supplies the n8 provider variant. Selection does not establish responsibility, submission or completion.
limitations: The Delaware bindings name n4/default. Foreign choices require supported downstream workflows.
Tax applicability cannot be inferred solely from formation country.
Presentation bindings are not canonical API instructions or a typed applicability model.
Downstream geographic applicability findings remain unresolved.

atlasFilingClarification.guidance: For an eligible stock transfer where an 83(b) election has been chosen, confirm the actual transfer date and the 30-day filing deadline, including the IRS weekend and legal-holiday rule. Atlas describes automatic filing for its C-corp founders; confirm that it is handling this election. Track the filing and retain the signed election. Use Atlas’s proof-of-filing document and the official USPS tracking record to check the mailing event against the deadline. Provide a copy to the company for which services were performed and to any different transferee, then retain the copies with the filing record.
atlasFilingClarification.reason: Required copies must be provided to the company for which services were performed and any different transferee. Atlas and USPS records support checking the filing event against the deadline.
